newsitem.title: MALTA: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA BEAT MALTA 2-0 TO GO JOINT SECOND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SLOVAKIA BEAT MALTA 2-0 TO GO JOINT SECOND.

text.p: Slovakia beat Malta 2-0 away on Monday to draw level on points with Yugoslavia in World Cup qualifying group six.
Tibor Jancula put the Slovaks ahead in the 39th minute and Dusan Tittel added a second two minutes into injury time.
The Maltese, weakened by the absence of four key players through injury and suspension, were always on the defensive but their reserve goalkeeper Mario Muscat was outstanding.
Jancula broke the deadlock late in the first half when he broke almost from the halfway line and placed the ball beyond the reach of the advancing Muscat.

Maltese defender Lawrence Attard was unlucky not to head home from a corner a few minutes after the interval and Slovak keeper Alexander Vancel saved a powerful shot from outside the box by Joseph Brincat.
Ten minutes later Brincat beat Vancel only to see his goal ruled offside.
Tittel scored Slovakia's second goal in injury time with a header.
Slovakia lie joint second in the group, four points behind leaders Spain. Malta have lost all six of their matches, conceding 27 goals without scoring any.
